text:
Priya (Docs): Heads-up: PR 9210 preview is red. playground and dashboard examples error with `KeyError: 'cost_sample_rate'`. Seems the telemetry field was renamed to `sampling.rate` and a bunch of snippets didn't get updated.
Marco (Eng-Obs): correct, we flattened sampling config into `sampling.rate` last sprint. the runtime still accepts the old key for now via a shim, but docs render fails because the JS snippet passes it as an option to the new helper which validates keys.
Sam (SDK): i'll open a micro PR to update snippets across Node/TS/Ruby and add a short migration note. can also add a helpful one-liner showing how to mass-replace in the repo.
Priya (Docs): please include both a YAML before/after and a minimal TS example. preview build blocks merges until the site renders cleanly.
Sam (SDK): PR 9213 opened, updates include: TS sample, YAML diff, sed example. TS snippet: ```ts
// prefer 'sampling.rate' but show fallback during rollout
const cfg = { sampling: { rate: 0.05 } } as const;
obsClient.configure(cfg as any);
```
Vera (Platform): small ask: change absolute links in the doc to relative paths (../playground) — preview blocks on prod-only domains and causes flakiness. saw two hardcoded links causing outbound calls.
Ike (QA): once PR merged, i'll run the smoke curl: `curl -s -X POST https://docs-preview.redwood.ai/api/render -d '{"example":"sampling-rate"}'` and paste the output.
preview-bot: PR 9210 preview: render-check failed (snippet validation error)
Sam (SDK): also removed an orphaned sample file `examples/legacy/cost-sample.yaml` that was picked up by the indexer and referenced the old key. left a short migration note in the top of the guide: "cost_sample_rate -> sampling.rate" with a copyable diff.
Marco (Eng-Obs): i'll sweep redirects and remove the stale `/console/observability/cost-sample` redirect that's confusing search results. will add a changelog bullet.
Ike (QA): smoke after merge: `HTTP 200` and inspector shows `\{"sampling\":{\"rate\":0.05},\"cost\":{\"units\":7}}` and no stack traces. good to merge.
Priya (Docs): thanks everyone. merging once CI is green. leaving a tiny follow-up to add a short cross-link from the migration guide to the dashboard presets page. :tada:
